description: The solution must ground on private enterprise data rather than model parametric knowledge alone.
label: Uses private enterprise data

description: Responses must be traceable back to the source they were grounded in.
label: Needs source citations

description: The corpus is larger than fits in a single model context window.
label: Large document corpus

description: The underlying source documents change frequently and must be kept fresh.
label: Frequently changing content

description: Different callers must see different subsets of the data based on their own entitlements.
label: Per-user data access

description: The data involved includes personally identifiable information.
label: Contains personal data (PII)

description: The data involved includes protected health information.
label: Contains health data (PHI)

description: The solution must mutate a system of record, not just inform a human.
label: Takes action on systems

description: Action capability is explicitly planned for a later increment, not the current one.
label: Actions planned for later

description: At least one action the solution can take cannot be trivially undone.
label: Irreversible actions

description: Actions or decisions carry direct financial consequence.
label: Financial impact

description: The primary interaction mode is synchronous, multi-turn conversation.
label: Conversational interaction

description: The primary interaction mode is scheduled or event-triggered, with no user waiting synchronously.
label: Scheduled or batch processing

description: Responses must return within a tight, human-perceptible latency budget.
label: Needs fast responses

description: Answering typical questions requires combining evidence from more than one retrieval hop.
label: Multi-step questions

description: Incoming queries are frequently ambiguous and benefit from query planning or clarification before retrieval.
label: Ambiguous questions

description: The domain has a rich entity/relationship structure that answers must traverse.
label: Needs relationship mapping

description: The work required to satisfy a request is a variable, multi-step task rather than a single call.
label: Multi-step tasks

description: The work decomposes into subtasks that are independent of one another and can run in parallel.
label: Independent parallel tasks

description: The work spans domains owned by different teams with different permission boundaries.
label: Spans multiple teams

description: Expected request or record volume is high enough that per-unit cost and throughput matter.
label: High request volume

description: Inputs include images, scans, or diagrams the model must read.
label: Includes images

description: The primary data source is structured/tabular rather than document text.
label: Structured or tabular data

description: A demonstrated, specific style/format/vocabulary requirement cannot be met by prompting or retrieval alone.
label: Needs a custom writing style

description: The requester has explicitly expressed a strong preference to reuse existing enterprise capability.
label: Strong reuse preference
